summary: Frontend testing of CursorGrid integration and StartScreen redesign. All critical flows working correctly.

issues: Background color is light (#F7F8FA = rgb(247,248,250)) not dark (#0E1116). Light theme is being applied instead of dark. The CursorGrid canvas renders behind the glass card but the background is white/light, not the intended dark surface. This is because the Playwright browser defaults to light mode and the app uses the system color scheme.

action_items: MINOR: The StartScreen background shows light theme (#F7F8FA) in web preview - the app uses system color scheme detection (setColorScheme(null)) so dark mode only appears when OS/browser is dark. Consider forcing dark theme on the StartScreen or document that dark theme requires OS-level dark mode enabled. This is not a bug per se, just a design consideration.
critical_code_review_comments: cursor-grid.tsx (native) imports CursorGridProps from cursor-grid.web.tsx - this works but is a cross-platform import that could cause issues in some bundler configurations. It works here since Metro handles it, but worth noting.

The LinearGradient in StartScreen uses pointerEvents='none' as a style prop which is React Native-only - on web this renders as a div with no CSS pointer-events property. However since it's a gradient overlay, it doesn't block interaction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows pass: StartScreen renders with MailMind AI branding (light theme in browser), start-button is clickable, Home screen with 4 tabs renders, Analyze tab works with form fields. CursorGrid web canvas component is embedded correctly. Theme issue: browser defaults to light mode so background is #F7F8FA not #0E1116 - not a bug.
